about_the_game:
Kingdom’s Path is a strategic 3D tower defense game with roguelite elements, where you expand your map using randomly offered 5x5 zone tiles.

    Each zone includes predefined paths, elevation layers, and tower placement spots.

    At the end of each wave, a new zone reshapes enemy routes based on your placement.

    Place towers on higher ground to gain extra range, and adapt your defense based on your chosen leader’s passive effects.

    Unlock new blueprints over time to build diverse structures and towers.

    With roguelite mechanics and strategic zone placement, every playthrough offers a unique tactical challenge.

Shape the Path, Shape the World

    After each wave, choose one of several randomly offered 5x5 zone tiles to expand your kingdom. Each zone contains preset paths and varied terrain elevations. Zones must connect to existing roads, making each placement a tactical decision.

Elevation-Based Strategy

Towers can be placed on tiles with varying height levels. Higher elevation means greater range. Build on the right layer at the right time to maximize your defenses.

Tower Blueprint System

    After each wave, choose one of several blueprints — new towers or support structures — to add to your arsenal. Spend gold to construct them during future waves, adapting your defense to the evolving battlefield.

Roguelite Replayability

    Unlock new leaders, passive effects, and blueprints as you progress. Each leader offers unique passive bonuses and strategic possibilities. With randomized zones, blueprint options, and enemy compositions, no two runs are the same.
